page_title: Framer: Free website builder and AI design agent

summary.name: Framer
summary.one_liner: Framer is a website builder with an AI design agent, an editable design canvas, and built-in hosting, CMS, analytics, SEO and AEO.
use_cases: Design and launch a startup landing page
Create layout variations of an existing site
Run and update a blog or CMS collection
Import content into a CMS from another platform
Add custom code effects with an agent
summary.what_it_does: Framer lets you describe what you need and a design agent builds layouts, sections and components on a fully editable canvas. You can adjust type, components, breakpoints and effects directly. Hosting, CMS, analytics, SEO and AEO are included so sites can be published without a separate build process. The CMS has its own agent that sets up and updates collections and keeps content synced with the canvas. Framer also offers an MCP server so external agents such as Claude Code, Codex and Cursor can update copy, import CMS content and make changes, with review on the canvas before publishing.
notable: AI design agent that builds and refines layouts on an editable canvas
CMS agent that syncs content with the design canvas
MCP server for connecting Claude, Codex, Cursor or other MCP-compatible agents
Built-in hosting, analytics, SEO and AEO
caveats: Page describes the site as free but does not detail which features require paid tiers
Listed on awesome-mac under prototyping tools, but the page itself names no macOS app
